backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor defining data types (UserProfile, NutritionDay, SleepDay, MovementDay, StressDay) and CRUD endpoints for user profiles, fasting schedules, nutrition/sleep/movement/stress entries, plus admin-controlled ICP payment activation gating.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades the actor state by adding `ownerIcpAddress` (empty string) and `userActivationStatus` (empty map) fields to the existing actor data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two implemented features: the PaymentGate frontend screen and its integration into the app-level auth flow, with associated file paths, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and recent changes, serving as a reference for build planning and code navigation.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark themes (backgrounds, borders, charts, sidebar) using Tailwind base/components/utilities layers.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the LivSpan app that forces dark mode on load via an inline script and mounts the React app at `#root`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that orchestrates auth state: shows a loading screen during initialization, a PaymentGate for authenticated-but-unactivated users, and the full StartDashboard for activated users.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component using Internet Identity, displaying a spinner during login and styled gradient/outline variants based on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/auth/PaymentGate: Renders a full-screen payment gate UI that displays an ICP wallet address (fetched via hook) with a copy button, fee info, and a login button, styled with a DNA helix background.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Factor: A clickable card component representing a health factor marker on the dashboard, with selection state reflected via gradient backgrounds and a connector line to a helix visual.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Fastin: A settings card that lets authenticated users view and edit their intermittent fasting schedule (start/end hours), persisting changes via a save mutation and notifying a parent component on change.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Interm: Dashboard panel displaying the user's current fasting phase, a live countdown timer, and progress bar based on their saved fasting schedule, with an embedded FastingScheduleSettings component for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Moveme: Dashboard panel for logging daily movement data, including activity type selector, intensity toggle, and active minutes input, with save/load functionality via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Nutrit: Dashboard panel for tracking daily nutrition inputs (calories, protein, water, body weight) with gradient sliders and progress bars, BMI/protein target calculations, and fasting-window-aware state loaded from user profile and schedule hooks.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/SleepP: Dashboard panel for logging and displaying today's sleep data, featuring gradient sliders for duration and quality score inputs, with React Query hooks for fetching and saving sleep entries.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Stress: Dashboard panel for recording daily cardiovascular stress metrics (blood pressure and pulse), with numeric input fields and React Query hooks for fetching and saving stress data.
frontend/src/components/genome/AnimatedH: SVG-based animated DNA double helix background component with gradient strands, connecting base pairs, and glow filters using CSS animations.
frontend/src/components/genome/HelixSpin: Layout wrapper that renders an animated SVG DNA helix spine with base pairs as a decorative background, centering child content along a vertical axis.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSwi: Toggle button component that switches the app language between English and German, highlighting the active language using the i18n context.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileO: Gate component that shows a login prompt for unauthenticated users or a profile-setup modal for authenticated users without a profile, before rendering child content.
frontend/src/hooks/queryKeys.ts: Centralized definition of React Query cache keys for all data domains including user profile, nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, and activation.
React Query hooks for checking whether a user has paid the 1 ICP activation fee (polling every 30 seconds) and for fetching the owner's ICP payment address.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingScheduleQue: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save the current user's fasting schedule via the backend actor, with toast notifications on save.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingWindowTimer: A hook that calculates and updates every second the current fasting/eating phase, elapsed time, remaining time, and progress percentage based on a configurable or default 16:8 schedule.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useMovementQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save a user's movement day entry for a given date (defaulting to today) via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save today's nutrition entry for the authenticated user via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSleepQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save today's sleep entry for the current user via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useStressQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save a user's stress day entry for a given date (defaulting to today) via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfileQueries: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save the current user's profile via the backend actor, with loading state that accounts for actor initialization to prevent UI flashes.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageProvider.tsx: A React context provider that manages the app's language state (English or German), persisting the selection to localStorage and defaulting to the browser's language.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Defines TypeScript types for supported languages and the full translations interface structure covering all UI sections (header, auth, panels, etc.).
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Custom React hook that retrieves the i18n context from LanguageProvider, throwing an error if used outside of it.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including color palettes, gradients, and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/fastingMetrics.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for fasting metrics calculation utilities.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionCalculations.t: Pure helper functions for client-side nutrition calculations including BMI, protein targets, progress percentages, and water intake tracking.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionGuidance.ts: Analyzes macro nutrient distribution (calories, protein, fat, carbs) and returns a deterministic guidance key for i18n lookup based on dietary balance rules.
frontend/src/lib/timeFormat.ts: Utility functions for formatting time durations into HH:MM:SS strings and hours with one decimal place.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a cn() utility function that merges Tailwind CSS class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/StartDashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page component that renders a DNA helix background, header with auth controls, and toggleable health factor panels (nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, fasting) along a helix spine.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors (helix palette, sage/teal scales, shadcn CSS-variable-based tokens), custom font families (Inter, JetBrains Mono), border radii, and keyframe animations for helix UI effects.
project_state.json: Project state descriptor for the LivSpan/Fasten-Dashboard app, documenting existing frontend payment-gate features and pending backend tasks (ICP wallet address storage, per-user activation tracking, and a query endpoint for the payment address) needed to implement a 1 ICP payment-gated access flow.
